basis: facts paraphrased from each provider's own website; links out; no endorsement

offerings.name: Advanced Blood Testing
offerings.summary: A one-off extended blood panel taken at a partner collection centre, with results tracked in an app and analysed by Everlab doctors.
includes: Blood panel of 90+ biomarkers (heart, hormones, metabolic, liver, kidney, iron, inflammation)
Results analysed by Everlab doctors, with personal reference ranges
Lifetime app access to track results over time
offerings.delivery: Blood collection at 1,850+ partner labs in every state; results and doctor insights delivered online
offerings.price: $598 one-time payment; Medicare-covered tests are included in the price and it is the total out-of-pocket cost

offerings.name: Longevity & Healthspan Program
offerings.summary: Online program where a doctor orders a longevity and metabolic blood panel, reviews it with you by video and sets a treatment protocol with 3-monthly reviews.
includes: Longevity and metabolic blood panel of 15+ markers at any of 4,000+ collection centres
45 to 60 minute telehealth consult with an AHPRA-registered doctor
Ongoing care with 3-monthly reviews
offerings.delivery: Telehealth only; blood collection at accredited centres Australia-wide
offerings.eligibility: Doctor confirms suitability after an online pre-screen
offerings.clinicians: AHPRA-registered doctors in metabolic and preventive medicine

offerings.name: Opse Baseline
offerings.summary: Face-to-face preventive medicine assessment with one GP who reviews your history and past results, then agrees which tests are worth doing and why.
includes: Review of medical and family history and previous results
Risk profile and screening discussion, with a staged testing plan
Written next-steps plan from the same doctor
offerings.delivery: In person, Fortitude Valley (95 Robertson Street); tests done offsite with external providers
offerings.price: $950 for the Baseline consultation; blood tests and scans are extra and paid to the external provider
offerings.eligibility: Entry is by application; fully private (no Medicare rebate stated)

offerings.name: Longevity Clinic
offerings.summary: GP-led preventive pathway at a Brisbane northside general practice: an initial assessment, an advanced blood panel, then a results review and plan with your GP.
includes: Initial consult with a GP covering history, family history and goals
Advanced blood panel (inflammation, heart, metabolic, hormones, nutrients)
Results review with your GP, written plan and follow-up visits
offerings.delivery: In person, Aspley Arcade 2 Shopping Centre, 1368 Gympie Rd
offerings.eligibility: Adults; some parts may attract a Medicare rebate, comprehensive assessments often carry a private fee (ask reception)

offerings.name: Diabetes First Program
offerings.summary: 12-week program for people with or at risk of type 2 diabetes. A doctor reviews your glucose and body composition changes; you wear a CGM for the first month.
includes: Continuous glucose monitor for the first month
Doctor consults at the start and at week 12, plus weekly nurse, dietitian or diabetes educator check-ins
Body composition scales on loan and 9 months of follow-up support
offerings.eligibility: Type 2 diabetes, pre-diabetes or related conditions; may be fully funded by participating private health funds for eligible members
offerings.clinicians: Doctors, with nurses, dietitians and diabetes educators doing most weekly contacts

offerings.name: Home Sleep Study
offerings.summary: You wear a medical-grade sleep monitor at home overnight; a sleep scientist analyses it and a sleep physician reports a diagnosis and next steps.
includes: Overnight home monitor recording breathing, oxygen, heart rate and sleep position
Data analysed by a sleep scientist and reported by a sleep physician
Treatment pathway if needed (for example CPAP), with specialist consults in person or by telehealth
offerings.delivery: Set-up appointment at a clinic, study done at home; specialist consults at Tugun, Benowa or Pimpama or by telehealth
offerings.price: Bulk billed (no out-of-pocket cost) for eligible patients with a valid referral
offerings.eligibility: GP referral and Medicare card needed for bulk billing
offerings.note: Uses a clinical home sleep monitor, not a consumer wearable such as Oura or Apple Watch.

offerings.name: Diabetes Australia Telehealth Clinic
offerings.summary: Video or phone appointments for diabetes and pre-diabetes, including help with continuous glucose monitoring, medicines and eating plans.
includes: 45-minute initial consult and 20-minute reviews
Support with CGM and blood glucose monitoring
Diet, medicine and lifestyle guidance
offerings.price: Self-referred: $148 initial (45 min), $118 review (20 min). With GP chronic condition plan referral: $90 initial, $60 review, partly Medicare funded
offerings.eligibility: People with diabetes or pre-diabetes; Medicare subsidy needs a GP Chronic Condition Management Plan referral
offerings.clinicians: Credentialled diabetes educators and accredited dietitians (not doctors)

offerings.name: Menopause Optimisation
offerings.summary: Three-visit doctor-led program for perimenopause and menopause that looks at symptoms alongside bone, heart and metabolic health.
includes: Baseline menopause consult plus two structured follow-ups
Shared decisions on treatment options, with monitoring where needed
Bone and body composition, sleep, mood and genitourinary symptoms included in the plan
offerings.delivery: In person, Fortitude Valley (95 Robertson Street)
offerings.eligibility: Apply through the Baseline intake form; acceptance depends on fit and capacity; fully private; tests paid separately

offerings.name: Menopause Clinic
offerings.summary: Brisbane menopause clinic run by GPs with a women's health focus, offering extended appointments for perimenopause and menopause.
includes: Extended appointments with a menopause-focused GP
Assessment of symptoms such as hot flushes, sleep, mood and vaginal dryness
Discussion of hormone and other treatment options
offerings.clinicians: GPs (FRACGP) with an interest in menopause

offerings.name: Perimenopause & Menopause Clinic
offerings.summary: Two 30-minute GP visits a few weeks apart: the first for history, symptoms and screening, the second to review results and set a treatment plan.
includes: Two initial 30-minute GP appointments, 2 to 4 weeks apart
Preventive checks such as bone health, heart risk and cancer screening
Access to a physiotherapist for bone density and strength
offerings.delivery: In person, Family Doctors Plus Windsor
offerings.price: $250 per 30-minute initial appointment; about $148.10 to $165.10 out of pocket after the Medicare rebate
offerings.eligibility: Medicare rebate applies for eligible patients

offerings.name: Menopause Telehealth Consultation
offerings.summary: Telehealth menopause service run by women's health GPs. A long first consult, with prescriptions, test requests and a summary for your own GP.
includes: Online pre-consult assessment, then a 45 to 60 minute phone or video consult
Prescriptions, blood test and scan requests, and referral letters as needed
Written summary and plan you can share with your regular GP
offerings.price: $360 initial consult (Medicare rebate $128.35); $185 follow-up (rebate $87.10); concession card holders pay a reduced gap
offerings.eligibility: Anyone with a perimenopause or menopause concern; Medicare rebate for eligible patients
